task: Make the synthetic exporter write a stable byte order
conditions: the fixture vault is generated from synthetic records only
the exporter is run twice with the same inputs
actions: sort exported records by a stable key before writing
compare the two exports byte for byte

scope_reviewed: the two generated exports and their byte comparison
the exporter test that asserts stable output
not_reviewed: concurrent writes from a second process
names with characters outside the fixture set

counterexamples: a run where two records share the same sort key is not covered
invalidated_when: the export format gains a field whose order depends on wall-clock time
title: Synthetic experience point: stable exporter ordering
